module.name: speak
module.description: Inline speakable text: renders its body inline with a small play mark; clicking speaks it with machine TTS (window.mdpTts) and highlights the words as they are read. The lightweight sibling of @speakcard (no translation/reading-note rows).
module.aiSpec:
Wrap a phrase or sentence INSIDE running text to make it speakable: the body renders inline (with a small ▶ mark before it), clicking it reads it aloud via the app's TTS (window.mdpTts) with read-along word highlighting; clicking again stops. Use @speakcard instead when you want the full card (sentence + smaller translation + reading note). Undecorated by design — the text keeps its surrounding style.
Gotcha: declared as a block module but renders INLINE, so it flows within the surrounding sentence. The body is the spoken text (inline Markdown allowed); the spoken string is the body's plain text.
Parameters: • lang (text, default en-US) — BCP-47 language; picks the narrator automatically. • voice (text, default '') — Web Speech narrator by name, substring ok (e.g. Zira). • speaker (number, default -1) — VOICEVOX style id, used when lang is Japanese (-1 = use Web Speech; auto-falls back to Web Speech if the engine is down). • rate (number, default 1) — speaking rate (0.5–2). • highlight (boolean, default true) — highlight the words as they are spoken. • icon (boolean, default true) — show the small ▶ mark before the text.
Example: The verb <!-- @speak lang: en-US -->**boils**<!-- @end --> is in the present tense. Full sentence: <!-- @speak rate: 0.9 -->Water boils at 100 °C.<!-- @end -->
